name: Cockpit HUD
author: Sedz
description: A full HUD on the steering wheel display, built to replace the game's on-screen one. Three pages (race, car damage, pit), switched by a button: lap time and live delta, gear, RPM, speed, position, lap, gaps, tyre temperatures and wear, fuel, ERS SOC with the straight mode / DRS badge, a drawn car coloured by damage, the pit window, rejoin position and pit stop time. Flags, safety cars, the pit limiter, penalties and the chequered flag take the whole screen; setting changes and warnings pop up. Reads the game's own UDP telemetry packets in the game (passed through unchanged, no sockets opened).

options.label: Delta against
options.description: What the live delta compares your lap with: the previous lap or your best lap of the session.

options.label: Flag screen
options.description: Flags (red flag, safety car, VSC, yellow, blue) fill the whole screen: briefly when they come out (4 s, then a blinking strip along the top and bottom edges), or for as long as they are out.

options.label: Page button (UDP Action)
options.description: Bind a button (wheel, controller or keyboard) to this "UDP Action" in the game's Controls menu: it steps through the race, car and pit pages. 0 turns it off. Needs the game's UDP telemetry on.

options.label: Tyre wear amber from (%)
options.description: Tyre wear from this shows amber.

options.label: Tyre wear red from (%)
options.description: Tyre wear from this shows red.

options.label: Ferrari wheel correction
options.description: Fixes the 2026 Ferrari steering wheel's bent display (a game bug: the game's own display bends there too). Leave it on; turn it off only if a game update or a car mod changes that wheel. Other cars are not affected.

options.label: Calibration grid
options.description: Draws a straight grid over the whole steering wheel display, for measuring how a wheel bends its screen. Not for racing: it covers everything.

options.label: Debug log
options.description: Write the HUD's lap timing and values to swofty/loader.log every 10 seconds.
